summary: Iteration 3 (Voice Cloning page). Backend: 28/28 pytest passed, including 8 new TestVoiceClone tests covering auth guards (401 on GET /voice/clone, /voice/clone/sample, POST /voice/clone), empty-file 400, >8MB 400, too-short sample graceful 424, successful 7s wav upload (persisted in Mongo GridFS 'voice_samples'), GET /voice/clone returns has_sample=true + duration_sec, GET /voice/clone/sample returns audio blob, POST /voice/clone/speak graceful 424 (Frasberg warming up / HTTP 520 upstream). Regression: /sts still returns graceful 424, /tts, /generate, /engines/status, auth, jobs, lockout all green. Frontend: /voice-clone logged-out shows clone-login-required + clone-login-btn opens AuthModal; logged in (token via /api/auth/login) shows clone-sample-status 'No sample yet', upload input accepts 7s wav -> status becomes 'Saved · 7s' and clone-sample-audio appears; clone-speak-btn correctly disabled until sample exists, enabled with sample+text; speak click returns 424 and surfaces 'Frasberg: Frasberg returned HTTP 520' sonner toast (expected upstream state). Tools grid #tools has 'Voice Cloning' card navigating to /voice-clone.
action_items: No blocking action items. Voice Cloning acceptance criteria fully met.

(Optional) VoiceClone.jsx: upload() uses await load() which re-fetches blob; good. However success toast is shown before load completes — if load fails the UI silently swallows it (catch(()=>{})). Consider surfacing load errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py voice_clone_speak: re-uploads sample to Frasberg on every speak call via frasberg_upload('/voice/clone', ...). This is wasteful (upload + bytes read from GridFS each call). Consider caching upstream clone_id/voice_id returned by Frasberg and reusing it in /voice/speak via a voice param.

server.py voice_clone: no MIME/type validation on uploaded file (any content-type accepted). A malicious client could upload non-audio bytes up to 8MB and store them in GridFS. Consider restricting to audio/* content_type.
server.py: no cleanup of previously-stored GridFS sample when a user re-uploads — old file_id is orphaned in voice_samples bucket. Delete prior fs file before setting new voice_clone on user doc.
VoiceClone.jsx: on logout while on this page, sampleUrl blob URL is not revoked (only revoked when a new one replaces it) — minor memory leak. Add cleanup in useEffect return.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded a 7s 16kHz sine-wave WAV sample for the test user into GridFS bucket voice_samples during the valid-upload test. Can be safely left in place.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has 28 tests including TestVoiceClone with a _gen_wav() helper that produces a 7s mono 16kHz PCM WAV. Voice cloning upload persists to Mongo GridFS bucket 'voice_samples' and sets user.voice_clone = {file_id, filename, content_type, duration_sec, created_at}. Frontend uses luchii_token in localStorage; setting it + reload is a fast way to bypass the AuthModal in tests. Frasberg /voice/speak currently returns HTTP 520 ('warming up') upstream, which the UI surfaces via sonner toast — this is not a bug.
